notes: Originals are user-supplied screenshots; every fixture and template is an unscaled, unfiltered crop.
The original client alpha channel is uniformly 255; RGB output preserves all visible pixel values.
Template roi is a search rectangle; template_crops below are exact extraction rectangles. All rectangles use x,y,width,height.
Use templates include an icon fragment, colored cap and outer border, not only the shared white label.
Thresholds are calibrated offline on these exact reference screenshots, not on live capture or animation frames.
Use/rating-confirm threshold 0.98 also rejects disabled states under grayscale 1-TM_SQDIFF_NORMED scoring.
Star templates are single stars. Center a 50x50 search window, from each template roi width/height, on each star_points center.
selected_marker is mandatory. Work selected ROIs are ordered 05:00,12:00,18:00; only first/third selected positives are provided, and the middle ROI follows the observed middle card geometry.

love_selected_offset_roi is relative to the card background anchor origin. LoveBentoScanner.visible_cards top_left is capture-local: add scanner.capture_roi origin [97,111] before applying the offset for a client-image match.
The love_usable first card anchor is capture-local [15,236], client [112,347]. Its marker template top-left is client [306,347]. Offset [190,-4,36,35] gives client search ROI [302,343,36,35].
rating_page uses the static explanation below the changing rating message; confirm_use excludes the item name; effect excludes all changing numbers.
work_not_issued has no single-use button, unlike work_disabled. All three use-template matches must be absent there.
Effect text visibly reports 36 recovered, while the displayed endpoints are 324 and 287. Preserve this screenshot evidence without inferring arithmetic or OCR correctness.

Recovery ROIs isolate the actual signed recovery amount printed on each card, excluding the fatigue icon. Expected text below is visually transcribed from the supplied screenshot, not a template confidence, catalog/base value, or arithmetic estimate.
Work recovery ROIs are ordered 05:00,12:00,18:00. The first two have visible -36 positives; the unissued third slot has no recovery digits in the supplied fixtures.

love_recovery_offset_roi uses the same background anchor coordinate conversion as love_selected_offset_roi. Anchor client [112,347] plus [178,163,32,22] gives [290,510,32,22], visibly -46 on the selected curry.
